title: Maine Head Start Grantees
before:
Head Start in Maine is supported by twelve local grantees providing comprehensive early learning and family support services across the state. Programs are organized below by region. Click any website link to learn more about a program's services, enrollment, and locations.

For a printable reference, download the Maine Head Start Programs directory (PDF).

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 1 address is shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — stacie.mccoy@maine.gov → Stacie.Mccoy@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.
